remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)

add_definitions(
    -Dstrcasecmp=_stricmp
    -Dstrncasecmp=_strnicmp
)
spec2def(inseng.dll inseng.spec)

# inseng.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/inseng-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(inseng_shims OBJECT icif.c inf.c inseng_main.c guid.c)
target_link_libraries(inseng_shims PRIVATE uuid wine libole32 liburlmon libkernel32_vista libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(inseng_shims)
add_cargo_module(inseng inseng-cargo inseng.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS inseng_shims psdk uuid_sources)
